# Event: Sink Battle (All Rewards)

![Event: Sink Battle (All Rewards)](/uploads/589_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The Burning Springs update expands the map from Appalachia west into the Ohio desert. There are numerous changes, new quests, new enemies, new weapons and new events. One of the **new public events is "Senkenschlacht".** This event will probably run again on the hour in the honeymoon phase for 14 days after the release of Burning Springs on **December 2nd, 2025** together with the "Event: Well Equipped". The events will then be included in the normal public event rotation and will start randomly every 20 minutes alongside all other public events.

![Location: Tycoon Lake (Event: Sinkhole Battle)](/uploads/nukaknights-post-event-sinkhole-solutions-location.jpg) 

The event **“Sinkhole Solutions”** takes place at **Tycoon Lake**, where aggressive insects have taken up residence. A nest of these creatures was located in the ancient lake. Your job is to activate the **Stomper** and eliminate the threat once and for all. Mainly the nests are destroyed here and RAD scorpions are fought while a sandstorm rages around the players.

Legendary enemies spawn during the event and the Deathclaw in the finale is also legendary. From these enemies you will receive legendary items such as weapons and armor.

### Sink Battle: Event Rewards

- 1000 XP
- 1000 bottle caps
- 1-3 Legendary Modules
- 3 government bonds
- 1-2 Rad-X / Rad-X diluted
- Random ammo
- 1 Stimpak / Super Stimpak
